Discretizing the image at any resolution therefore produces a matrix whose rows fall into one of two families:

- rows that intersect the white regions (exactly two intervals of entries equal to \(b\), with all other entries equal to \(a\)).

Consequently the matrix possesses only two distinct row vectors. These two vectors are linearly independent whenever \(a\neq b\), so the row space has dimension exactly 2. No choice of grid size can increase the number of distinct row vectors, and therefore the rank cannot exceed 2.

Thus the maximal possible rank is 2.
